mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.max_slots, t.registration_opens_at, t.registration_closes_at, t.starts_at, t.created_by, t.created_at, t.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournaments (title, description, status, max_slots, registration_opens_at, registration_closes_at, starts_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{maxSlots}, #{registrationOpensAt}, #{registrationClosesAt}, #{startsAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations r WHERE r.tournament_id = t.id AND r.status = 'registered') AS registration_count FROM tournaments t WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations r WHERE r.tournament_id = t.id AND r.status = 'registered') AS registration_count FROM tournaments t WHERE t.status IN ('registration', 'closed', 'ongoing', 'finished') ORDER BY CASE t.status WHEN 'ongoing' THEN 1 WHEN 'registration' THEN 2 WHEN 'closed' THEN 3 WHEN 'finished' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, t.created_at DESC
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations r WHERE r.tournament_id = t.id AND r.status = 'registered') AS registration_count FROM tournaments t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'registered'
